main_text.head: XVIII.
main_text.p: Forma Syrorum Passiva Prima & Secunda Conjugationis rectius Ethpeel, & Ethpaal, quàm Ethpeal & Ethpaël denominantur. ܐܬܦܥܠ ܐܬܦܥܠ
main_text.head: PRÆSIDIS,
Ad Præstantissimum, Ornatissimum ac Doctissimum Dominum RESPONDENTEM,
EPIGRAMMA.
main_text.p: E tenebris alii lucem venantur opacis: Et sequitur matrem filia sæpe suam. Tu tibi Divinâ de Luce accendere Lucem; Tu lustrare Sacrâ Lumina Luce cupis. Macte hoc proposito! Cœlum tua coepta secundet! Sic, LOMBARDI ardens Tu bene Lumen eris.

page.notes: The Hebrew, Syriac and fleuron rows are reproduced only in outline; the exact Hebrew and Syriac letters are not fully legible at this scan resolution. The epigram is set in verse lines, with the initial E and italic words kept as far as visible.
